description: Feed NW SAPOS Geodätischer Postprocessing Positionierungs-Service (GPPS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opengeodata.nrw.de. Download the NRW database SAPOS Geodetic Postprocessing Positioning Service (GPPS) as atomic feed. The satellite positioning service of the German state survey SAPOS offers nationwide access to the official spatial reference by centimetre-precise positioning via GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems) in the reference system ETRS89. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Atom Feed NW SAPOS Geodetic Postprocessing Positioning Service (GPPS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include sapos, SAPOS, dez71, Geobasisdaten, Atom-Feed, Festpunkte. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ATOM. The listing shows 2026-01-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
